# Accessrank

> Accessrank fixes accessibility in the source code of DTC ecommerce stores — WCAG 2.2 Level AA remediation, documented and re-verified — and the same structural fixes improve SEO and AI/agent readiness. No overlay widgets.

Accessrank scans a store in a real browser with axe-core, fixes the failures directly in the theme or codebase (Shopify fixes go to a draft theme and are approved change by change), re-scans until zero issues remain, and delivers an evidence pack: rule, WCAG criterion and before-and-after screenshots for every fix. A free automated check runs on the homepage.

## Main pages

- [Homepage and free accessibility check](https://accessrank.ai/home): what the service does, the WCAG 2.2 principles in plain English, pricing and FAQ; the free check scores a page against WCAG 2.2 AA and on-page SEO.
- [Methodology](https://accessrank.ai/methodology): how the audit engine works and how the accessibility and SEO scores are calculated.
- [ADA and EAA guide](https://accessrank.ai/guide/ada-eaa): the ADA, the European Accessibility Act and what they mean for online stores.
- [Citations](https://accessrank.ai/citations): sources for every statistic on the site.
- [Resources](https://accessrank.ai/resources): further reading.
- [About](https://accessrank.ai/about): the company.

## Pricing

- Starter: $1,500 one-time onboarding, then $79/month — single-line stores with up to 10 SKUs.
- Growth: $3,500 one-time onboarding, then $249/month — growing brands with 10–100 SKUs.
- Enterprise: custom — Shopify Plus and multi-brand catalogs, 100+ SKUs.
- Lawsuit response: from $5,900, delivered in about 7 days — for businesses already served a demand letter or lawsuit.
